items.title: Most tokenized stock trading on Solana, BNB Chain occurs outside US market hours
items.summary: Tokenized equities have reached nearly $3.3 billion in value as investors embrace round-the-clock access beyond Wall Street hours.

items.title: OpenAI Engineer Arrested for Bugging Office, Company Says AI Caught Him
items.summary: A Saudi national working at OpenAI allegedly hid an encrypted audio recorder behind a TV in an executive meeting room. OpenAI says its own models helped trace it back to him.

items.title: Ripple, Stripe-owned Privy partner to bring embedded wallets to XRP Ledger
items.summary: Developers can now build XRPL wallets into apps via Privy, with support for XRP, RLUSD, AI agent payments and x402.

items.title: Lido DAO exposes token flaw and forces a budget review
items.summary: A proposed budget link could pass genuine savings into LDO purchases, while corrected scenarios show why counter resets cannot improve underlying profit.

items.title: The Amount of Bitcoin on Exchanges Is Shrinking. Is a Rally Imminent?
items.summary: Exchange reserves continue to decline as holders move coins off platforms, a pattern historically associated with reduced sell pressure.

items.title: Bitcoin, ether slip and rebound as South Korean stocks slide on AI-related concerns
items.summary: Investors are positioning ahead of today's bank earnings reports and Wednesday's U.S. inflation data.
